notes.Precious Achiuwa: Keegan Murray is out again with ankle capsulitis, and Achiuwa played 39 minutes Sunday as the starter.
notes.Daniss Jenkins: Ausar Thompson is questionable, and Jenkins played 38 minutes when he started for him Sunday.
notes.Ron Holland: Ausar Thompson and Isaiah Joe are both questionable, which would open more wing minutes.
notes.Duncan Robinson: Isaiah Joe is questionable with a hip contusion, which would protect Robinson's minutes.
notes.Mitchell Robinson: He is expected to play the second night of the back-to-back.
notes.Neemias Queta: He takes the starting center minutes if Mitchell Robinson sits the second night of the back-to-back.
notes.Payton Pritchard: He scored 28 points in 22 minutes Monday in a blowout win, but much of that came from hot three-point shooting.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He played only 28 minutes Monday in a blowout and plays the second night of the back-to-back against Brooklyn.
notes.Domantas Sabonis: He keeps posting big rebound and assist totals while Keegan Murray and Sacramento's backup centers are out.
